dedupe_keys.name: pv free module and inverter parameter api

description: PV Free is a public API for photovoltaic module and inverter parameters used with pvlib models. The README says its current endpoint is an Azure-hosted service backed by PostgreSQL and notes that an older development site ended after an ElephantSQL migration. Users query equipment parameters and pass the returned values to their own PV calculation. Geographic coverage is not fixed; entries describe equipment, not installed plants. GitHub metadata states BSD-2-Clause licensing for the code, but availability of the hosted service and records is a separate operational matter. A limitation is that modelled performance depends on matching the exact product version and local weather, mounting and degradation assumptions. Database completeness and maintenance were not checked here. PV Free can help parameterise generation forecasts or capacity scenarios. The related ERA5 catalogue record supplies weather, not equipment parameters. No parameter table or API payload was downloaded.
